contexts.text: To till it and to guard it () = that it was conceded to him to enjoy all these things, but not to possess them as his own.
Am I my brother's keeper () = that it made charity of no account, and would not wait upon it.
To be a keeper = to serve, as gate-keepers, and the house-porters in the Jewish Church.
The Lord most especially guards man while he sleeps. AC 1983.
Under Covenant, see this reference.
As they... were guarded in the midst of falsities and evils... that night... is called a night of the guardings of Jehovah.
I will keep thee in all whither thou goest () = the Divine Providence.
If God... shall keep me in the way wherein I walk () = the continual Divine.
To guard, etc. the flock () = to apply to use.
Unless a man keeps these precepts not only in the external form, but also in the internal...
His father kept the word () = that the truth remained in their religiosity.
Such a dog = a guard, lest...
He gave them into custody () = rejection. AC 5089. AC 5101. AC 5110.
The custody into which Joseph was sent = a state of temptation.
Let them guard it () = there to he stored up. To guard = to store up; namely, in the interiors of the natural mind.
He shut them up in custody () = separation from himself.
That scientific truths, because from the Divine, were guarded. Signified. AC 6689.
To fear God = to keep what the Divine commands; for they who fear God keep the commandments.
It shall be to you for keeping () = the time and state of initiation.
Ye shall keep this day in your generations by an eternal statute () = worship from faith and charity according to Divine order. To keep = worship...
To keep this word even eternal () = that all this must be observed hereafter.
Ye shall keep this service () = worship on account of deliverance. To keep = that it was to be observed.

A night of the guardings of Jehovah () = the Lord's presence with those who are in truth and good; and with those who are in mere evil and... falsity... The guardings of Jehovah = the Lord's presence and the consequent protection.
Thou shalt keep this statute at a stated time from year to year () = that this law of order should be in this state constantly.

It came to pass in the morning watch () = a state of thick darkness and of the destruction of those who are in falsity from evil, and a state of the enlightenment and salvation of those who are in truth from good. Explained.

The night was divided into watches, of which the last of the night and the first of the day was the morning watch. The watchmen were upon the Avails, spying whether an enemy was coming, and by a cry announcing what they saw. By them... is meant the Lord; and by the watch, His continual presence and protection. Illustrated.
Watchmen also mean prophets and priests.
If thou wilt keep all His statutes () = life according to the truths of faith... To keep = to live.
For keeping even to the morning () = as if from the proprium.
How long do ye refuse to keep My precepts and My laws () = that they did not act according to Divine order.
For keeping to your generations () = which is for those who are of the Spiritual Church... To them for keeping = that it may be for a memorial. AC 8533.
To keep the covenant () = to live according to the precepts, thus in good, and thus to be conjoined with the Lord.

To keep these things = to live according to them; as is evident from the signification of to keep, in the Word; for it is frequently said to hear the precepts, and to keep them; and by to hear is signified to receive them in faith, and by to keep, to receive them in life; that is, to live according to them.
And keep My precepts () = those who receive the truths of faith. Explained.
And he hath not guarded him () = no repression... To guard, when said of the evil of the voluntary which has passed into the light of the intellectual, = to hold in or repress. AC 9096.

When a man shall have given his companion silver or vessels to keep () = truths from good and the corresponding scientifics, in the memory... To keep = in the memory; for, in the spiritual sense, in which it treats of truths and scientifics, to be kept = to be kept in the memory, because such things are kept in it. For a man to give to his companion to keep = to lay up with himself in the memory... AC 9162.
All that I have said unto you ye shall keep () = that the precepts, judgments, and statutes are to be done... To keep, or to observe, = to do.
To keep thee in the way () = His Providence and guard from the falsities of evil. To keep, when said of the Lord, = Providence. Explained.
Take heed of His face () = holy fear. Explained.

The Angels of Heaven and the men of the Church are guarded by the Lord through the elevation of their interiors to Himself; and when they are elevated they are in the good of love to Him and towards the neighbour. Thus are they guarded...

This Divine sphere extends itself also into the Hells, and guards them too... But with the difference, that the Divine sphere which... protects Heaven, is a sphere of Divine truth conjoined with Divine good; but that which guards Hell, is a sphere of Divine truth separated from Divine good... But still, in the internal form, there reigns in it the sphere of Divine truth conjoined with Divine good. By means of this latter sphere they are guarded there, lest anyone should inflict evil on another beyond the measure.
They were guards to prevent Spirits from this world from passing, without permission, into any other world in the universe.
(Thus) these Societies are guards to prevent the commingling of the two kinds of goods.
The covering = a guard lest the Ultimate Heaven should be entered; for the gate was guarded by the covering.
A watchman = one who observes the states of the Church, and its changes; thus every prophet.

My Sabbaths ye shall keep () = holy thought constantly concerning the union of the Divine Itself with the Lord's Human... Altogether to keep = to have holily and constantly in the thought; for when to keep is said of those things which were represented in that Church, it = to have in thought and mind the things which were represented, and to worship them holily... Therefore, to keep the Sabbaths of Jehovah = to think holily and constantly about the Lord, the union of His Divine with His Divine Human, etc.
Ye shall keep the Sabbath () = that the Lord's Divine Human is to be worshipped... To keep, when said of the Divine, = to worship.

To keep the Sabbath = holy thought constantly concerning the union of the Divine Itself with the Lord's Human; thus also acknowledgement; for thought without acknowledgement and faith is not spiritual thought.
Keep to thyself () = if they do so who acknowledge the Word.
Angels guard men. Explained.
They are delivered to the Angel guards there.
The spiritual sense is not given to anyone except by the Lord alone; and is guarded by Him as Heaven is guarded; for Heaven is in it.

The sense of the letter... is the guard for the genuine truths which lie hidden within; and it is a guard in this, that it can be turned hither and thither... It guards with those who are in falsities from religion, and do not confirm these falsities; for these do not inflict any violence on the Word. This guard is signified by the cherubs...
The devil shall cast some of you into custody () = that the good of their life will be infested by evils which are from Hell...

The reason to be sent into custody, or into prison, = to be infested, is that those who are infested by evils from Hell are as if bound in a prison; for they can think nothing but evil, when yet they will good.
To keep the works unto the end () = to be in them, and to remain in them even to the end of life. AE 174.
The Word of the Lord... and its guards. Signified. AR 245. AR 314.
That they were guarded by the Lord lest they should be seduced. Signified.
But after the Last Judgment... they are taken out of the guards.
A hold of every unclean Spirit... () = Hell, because they are imprisoned there. AE 1099.
Guards lest anyone should enter (into the New Jerusalem) unless he is in these Knowledges from the Lord. AR 900:2.
The first said... I passed the first guards, and also the second; but when I came to the third, the Commander of the guards accosted me...
When they ascended the Parnassian hill, some guards there brought water from the fountain...
If thou dost not guard thyself from evil, thou canst not be guarded by legions of Angels...
The guards opened the gate (of Heaven).
In the ascent there is a gate, and a guard there; he opens the gate...
He was placed to guard me... I heard that he was such a guard...
Wherever there are slopes to the mountains, there are those who keep guard...

The devil will cast some of you into custody = that those who are in falsities from evil will set about depriving them of all truth from the Word... For truths are as in custody, or in prison, when falsities break in.
The guard and Providence of the Lord lest the interior Heavens should be approached except by the good of love and of charity... Signified.
The appearance in ultimates of the Divine guard and Providence as to wisdom. Signified. AE 281.
As each good, celestial and spiritual, guards...
Full of eyes within = the Divine Providence and guard.
Keep the door of my lips. Explained.
Protection from evils and falsities, which otherwise would take away the influx, is meant by, May Jehovah keep thee and have mercy on thee.
To keep the Sabbath = to be in conjunction with the Lord.
Because from this love is all evil, and from this falsity, it is said, Jehovah will keep thee from all evil, He will keep thy soul ().
To keep it = to do it.
In the ways there are guards... Then those guards are removed...
By this Divine truth He guards.
To keep and to do = worship from the good of love.
To keep and to do the statutes and the precepts = the good of life, which is the same as the good of love; for he who loves lives.
To take hold of the hand and keep () = from Divine Omnipotence, which the Hells cannot resist.
To keep it = to live according to these things.
Satan shall be loosed out of his custody ().
Here are they that keep the commandments of God () = that these are they who live according to the precepts of the Lord in the Word.
